cases.title: Upgrade keeps an existing single-user install
steps: Start the server from main (before this change) with GM_PASSWORD=pw and a data dir, clone one repo and save a repository setting, stop it
Start this build with the same data dir and GM_PASSWORD=pw
POST /api/auth/login with {"username":"admin","password":"pw"}
GET /api/auth/me, GET /api/sessions, open Settings → Repositories
cases.expected: Login answers 204; /api/auth/me returns user admin; graph-manager.db exists and graph-manager.json was renamed graph-manager.json.imported; the saved repository setting and the clone are still there

cases.title: No Workspaces tab anywhere
steps: Build and start graph-manager with the fake forge as TESTING.md ("graph-manager" section) describes, with a fresh GM_DATA_DIR and GM_WORKSPACES_DIR, and connect GitHub with token gh-good
Open the UI in a browser and look at the nav, press Ctrl K and type "work", press g then w, open /workspaces
cases.expected: There is no Workspaces nav item or palette entry, g w does nothing, and /workspaces redirects to /terminals

cases.title: Open a terminal by picking a repository
steps: Build and start graph-manager with the fake forge as TESTING.md ("graph-manager" section) describes, with a fresh GM_DATA_DIR and GM_WORKSPACES_DIR, and connect GitHub with token gh-good
Click New terminal, search a repository of the fake forge, keep New branch, pick a plain shell, open
Open a second terminal on the same repository
cases.expected: The repository is cloned, the terminal opens in it on a branch named gm/admin-<date>-<4 chars>, the sidebar shows one live session for the repository with two terminals, and the second terminal did not ask for a branch

cases.title: Session cap and freeing a slot
steps: Start the server as in P3 with GM_MAX_SESSIONS=1
Open a terminal on repository A, then try to open one on repository B
Close the terminal of A (no changes), then open B
cases.expected: Opening B first answers 409 {"error":"You have 1 open repositories. Close all terminals of one to open another."} and the UI shows it; after closing A's last terminal, B opens

cases.title: Ask before closing a session with changes
steps: Build and start graph-manager with the fake forge as TESTING.md ("graph-manager" section) describes, with a fresh GM_DATA_DIR and GM_WORKSPACES_DIR, and connect GitHub with token gh-good
Open a terminal on a repository, run `echo x > new.txt && echo SECRET=1 > .env`
Close the terminal; in the dialog pick Push to branch
Check the fake forge's copy of the session branch
cases.expected: The dialog says "<repo> has uncommitted changes." with Push to branch, Keep open and Discard; after Push, new.txt is on the session branch on the forge, .env is not and is listed as skipped, and the session is gone

cases.title: Accounts, sign-up and isolation
steps: Start with GM_SIGNUP=open and GM_SESSION_RUNTIME=local
Sign up user alice in the UI, open a terminal on a repository, start a fake-provider run
Sign up user bob in another browser profile, GET /api/sessions, GET /api/runs and GET /api/runs/<alice's ws>/<run id> as bob
cases.expected: Both sign-ups work; bob sees no sessions or runs of alice, and alice's run answers 404 for bob

cases.title: Gateway mode
steps: Start with GM_AUTH=gateway and a 32+ character GM_GATEWAY_SECRET
GET /api/workspaces without a header, then with an X-GM-Identity token made with signIdentity for sub u1
POST /api/gateway/users/u1/disable with the secret as bearer, then repeat the identity request
cases.expected: Without a header 401 {"error":"gateway identity required"}; with the token 200 and user u1 exists; after disable 403 {"error":"account disabled"}; POST /api/auth/login answers 404

cases.title: Ended run stays in history with its logs
steps: Build and start graph-manager with the fake forge as TESTING.md ("graph-manager" section) describes, with a fresh GM_DATA_DIR and GM_WORKSPACES_DIR, and connect GitHub with token gh-good
Open a terminal on a repository and start a fake-provider run from Start run, wait until it is applied
Close the session with Discard, open the Runs page and the run
cases.expected: The run is listed after the session ended and opens read-only with the note "This session has ended. The run page is no longer live.", showing its task logs

cases.title: Workspace agent end to end
steps: Start `graph-manager agent --port 7700 --workspaces <tmp>` with GM_AGENT_TOKEN set to 32+ characters
curl /agent/v1/healthz, then any /agent/v1 call without the token and with it
cases.expected: healthz answers {"ok":true}; without the token 401; with it the call works

cases.title: CLI flow unchanged
steps: Run the engine CLI on the diamond fixture with --provider fake in a temp repo, as TESTING.md describes
Check `git diff main -- packages/graph-execution`
cases.expected: The run behaves exactly as before and reaches applied; the engine package has no changes
